standingAllowance.why: Permit2 has no owner and no proxy, and moves an owner's tokens only for a spender the owner approved on Permit2 itself, by its own call or signature (AllowanceTransfer.transferFrom), or for a transfer the owner signed (SignatureTransfer). An ERC-20 allowance to Permit2 alone lets no one move the Safe's tokens.

The router pulls tokens through Permit2 only from the address that called execute, its locker (msgSender() in Dispatcher.sol, set by Lock.sol): Permit2Payments.permit2TransferFrom takes msgSender() as the owner for V2, V3 and V4 swaps with payerIsUser and for PERMIT2_TRANSFER_FROM, and PERMIT2_TRANSFER_FROM_BATCH reverts when a transfer's from is not the locker. It has no owner and no proxy. So a Permit2 allowance to it can be spent only by a later execute the Safe itself makes.

universal-router-2.1.2.ignoresTrailer: UniversalRouter.execute(bytes,bytes[],uint256) reads only its ABI-decoded arguments: its verified source (contracts/UniversalRouter.sol, Dispatcher.sol and the modules) never reads msg.data or calldatasize, and it takes its caller from msg.sender through Lock.sol, never from calldata as an ERC-2771 contract does.
